newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stocks hold steady in light trading.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stocks hold steady in light trading.

text.p: Share prices on the Ghana Stock Exchange were mostly steady on Friday, with sentiment mixed and trading light, dealers said.
The ALL-Share index rose just 0.02 point to close at 386.17, up from 386.15 on Monday.
The volume of shares traded was low at 29,870, compared with 65,770 on Monday. Bids outpaced offers by 1,530,970 to 302,870.

The main riser was Mobil Oil Ghana MOG.GH, up 50 cedis to 6,500. The other gainers were Unilever UNI.GH, up 20 cedis to 900 cedis, trading company Paterson Zochonis, up five cedis to 255 cedis, and trading company CFAO CFAO.GH, up two cedis to 26 cedis.
The declining issues included Ghana Commercial Bank, down 10 cedis to 645 cedis, and Fan Milk Ltd, down one cedi to 387 cedis.
